name: Acceptance API
description: The acceptance run's fixture for the plugin API's served areas: one host MCP tool, ApiProbe, that reads its own log, the usage rows, Alpha's memory and the routines, runs its own command and is refused another plugin's, plays a silent clip as Alpha's voice, listens for push-to-talk, and is refused the clover tree's keys; then the rest of each area's members: the commands list, a memory file read, a routine's runs, the plan readings and a usage watch, its own log followed, and the computers (list, watch, a hold on a made-up app taken, listed and released, the action signal, Clover's windows, the user-working mark on a made-up app); it answers what each one gave.
